app.name: Wii CD Player
app.short_description: Play audio CDs from a USB optical drive
app.long_description:
Plays audio CDs from a USB CD/DVD drive plugged into the Wii, reading raw CD-DA over USB mass storage (SCSI/MMC READ CD). Shows CD-TEXT, supports repeat, shuffle and scanning.
Debug shell: nc <wii-ip> 5555 Log file: sd:/cdplayer.log
